name: HQS Quantum Simulations
description: HQS Quantum Simulations is a German quantum software company developing quantum simulation software for materials science and chemistry applications. The company provides quantum algorithms and software tools to accelerate materials discovery and chemical simulations for industrial and research purposes.

products.name: Qoqo Quantum Toolkit
products.description: Open-source quantum simulation toolkit for materials science and computational chemistry workflows

products.name: QUEST Platform
products.description: Quantum-enhanced simulation platform for accelerating industrial materials discovery and chemical research

highlights: Based in Karlsruhe, a hub for German quantum research near KIT
Focuses on near-term quantum advantage for industrial materials science and chemistry
Develops both proprietary and open-source quantum simulation tools
